scope: Static source and named frozen read-only snapshot only. No live result reads, no target/solver/native execution, no edits to existing scripts.

findings.title: Report-level selection cannot merge frozen partial batch 051 with recovery starting 052
findings.evidence: Each report selects its entire registered [start,start+limit) regardless of row state. Old batch 051 selects 51,52,53. Recovery [52,84) overlaps at 52,53 and duplicate guard raises. Omitting old report loses returned resource-stop slot 51; omitting recovery loses repaired logical slots.
findings.required_change: Create a new immutable explicit attempt-selection ledger: retain old report index 51; select new recovery report index 52 and 53 onward. Include original report hashes and index/key identity. Preserve old 52 STARTED/unfinished and old 53 NOT_RUN as alternatives, with selection reason. Do not edit raw supervisor selected range, delete failures, or use latest-wins.

verified_boundaries.resource_stop: v5 supervisor.py:151-152 requires no stop_reason, exit_code==0, worker COMPLETE and expectation not false. Frozen snapshot slots 19 and 39 record RSS_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE despite exit0/COMPLETE; they must remain non-strict. Slot 51 also remains resource-stop failure/unknown.
verified_boundaries.summary_strict: summarize_saved_v5.py:124 trusts recorded valid_completed_result, rather than reconstructing it. Correct frozen v5 records are safe. New recovery summarizer should independently assert not resource stop, no stop_reason, exit0, worker COMPLETE, valid_completed_result True and expectation not false; contradictory source fields must be an issue or rejection, never strict_success.
verified_boundaries.cpu_scope: cpu_sum_all_observed_seconds at lines 118-130 sums only selected logical-slot rows with full_process_cpu_seconds present. It is selected-attempt observed CPU, not all-attempt or whole-campaign cost. Missing interrupted attempt CPU is unavailable, not zero. Report selected-attempt CPU and all-observed-attempt CPU separately, deduplicate attempt identity, and state missing-cost count. Do not derive speedup from this partial/recovery accounting.
verified_boundaries.pooling: Lines 43-44,98-99 reject multiple declared runtime_lock_sha256 or program_sha256 mappings within one summarize call. Worker lock/suite/index and saved worker SHA are checked. Main and SpotIt must remain separate summaries/pools even with the same suite and numeric native version. This is a lock-based provenance check, not a fresh native execution audit.
verified_boundaries.program_provenance: Summary enforces single program_sha256 mapping internally but does not expose that mapping in returned JSON; include it in a new recovery summary for inspectable provenance.
verified_boundaries.denominator: Keep all 168 registered slots per kind, selected evidence once per logical slot; retain rejected contracts, unknown, resource-stop and not-run states. Extra interrupted attempts do not enlarge logical-slot denominator.
